title: Closed session decision recovery
summary: Unresolved user decisions must not be owned only by the session that created them. On a Subconscious nudge into any new active session for the same workspace, reconcile the pending decision set first: auto-resolve or dismiss decisions whose origin task is completed, canceled, superseded, or whose triggering condition no longer holds; deduplicate equivalent questions; then surface all remaining actionable decisions in the active conversation. Each decision blocks only its origin task and dependent branch, while unrelated work may continue. Re-surface with bounded reminders rather than on every nudge.
